covers: JSE close, the rand after the SARB hold, and the first 30 minutes of Wall Street, Thursday 19 November 2026
headline: Wall Street opens higher (Nasdaq +1.5%) as the rand weakens to R17.31/$ after the SARB's 4–3 hold; Dell +6.4%
summary: The JSE All Share was at 106,287.6 at 17:02 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, down 0.3% on the day and 5.4% on the week, and the rand weakened to R17.31 per dollar from R17.22 just before the SARB held the repo rate at 7.25% on a 4–3 vote (LRC Market Dashboard; BusinessTech, 19 Nov 2026). In New York, about half an hour after the open, the S&P 500 was up 0.7% at 7,378.18 and the Nasdaq up 1.5% at 24,802.73, with Dell up 6.4% and Palo Alto Networks up 7.4% (LRC Market Dashboard and Stock Scanner quotes, 17:02 SAST). Gold was at $3,708, down 4.6% on the week, while Brent rose 1.7% to $90.68 and the US 10-year yield was 5.09%.

items.title: Dell +6.4% to $333.09 at the US open; rating unchanged
items.summary: Dell traded at $333.09 at 17:02 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, up 6.4% on the day, after falling 3.0% to $313.11 on Wednesday. We have not yet verified a news item behind the move, so treat it as unexplained for now; chip and hardware shares were broadly higher in early trade (Nvidia +2.9%, Arista +1.3%). Dell is rated SELL on the LRC Watchlist (fair value $404.70; status 'Rejected (avoid)') and HOLD by the LRC Stock Scanner. Results are due on 24 Nov 2026. This note does not change either rating.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 19 Nov 2026 17:02 SAST; LRC Watchlist; LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026

items.title: SARB holds repo rate at 7.25%; MPC split 4–3, with three votes for a hike
items.summary: The Reserve Bank kept the repo rate at 7.25% on 19 Nov 2026. Four members voted to hold and three for a 25bp increase. Kganyago said near-term inflation is above 5%, in line with this week's 5.2% CPI reading, and that high prints are expected to last into early next year before easing. He said the committee is pausing "for now" and "will not hesitate to raise rates if needed" to bring inflation back to the 3% target. The close vote keeps a further hike on the table at the next meeting.
